judged_text: No HTTP method check on webhook endpoint (missing req.method !== "POST" validation)

record.issue_text: No HTTP method check on webhook endpoint (missing req.method !== "POST" validation)

adjudication.rationale: In the newly added Next.js API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the `handler` does not check `req.method` at all (no `if (req.method !== "POST") ...`). The endpoint performs auth checks and then immediately `parse`s `req.body` with Zod, which can be invoked via GET/PUT/etc. In particular, non-POST requests may have an empty/undefined body leading to an unhandled Zod parse exception (500) rather than a clean 405, and generally exposes the webhook logic to unintended HTTP methods. This is directly verifiable in the diff.
